name: The Empire
description: The series was inspired by the adult film industry of the 1990s and its well-known stars. It focuses not on the behind-the-scenes drama, but on people’s lives and the decisions they make. The new series from the creators of *The King* tells a story inspired by real events and wild fantasies.

videos.title: Beauty and the Seven Dwarfs
videos.overview: Kovi loses his job at the meatpacking plant just as he and Magdi are planning to have a baby. He comes up with a crazy idea: he’ll make the first Hungarian porn movie. However, the filming of *Hótehénke* runs into unexpected obstacles.

videos.title: Monique
videos.overview: Kovi realizes that to make a real breakthrough, he needs a star. That’s when Monique enters his life—her unique charisma immediately changes everything. At the same time, their shared success harbors dangers…

videos.title: Michelle
videos.overview: We meet Michelle, who is chasing her dreams of becoming an actress. Kovi falls completely under her spell, which makes Magdi increasingly uneasy.

videos.title: Maya
videos.overview: Magdi is looking for a new star to join Michelle, which is how Maya Gold enters the picture—she’s trying to break free from her family. Maya quickly feels at home in the world of film shoots, and Michelle senses she has a rival.

videos.title: Splendor
videos.overview: Luxx Video is at the top of its game, but Michelle longs for worldwide fame. Her attempt to break out upsets Kovi, who is starting to shoot a new movie.

videos.title: Long live eroticism
videos.overview: The porn industry is taking a new direction, and Kovi is finding it increasingly difficult to find his place in it. He gives in and takes part in the Erotika Expo, which brings out in everyone what they’ve been trying to hide until now…
